brief: A payments company argues against itself. 3.30% lands on beat 0 with the bed and the slab; the editorial line calls it terrible; the £4 card shows us losing in grey; the £40 card is the turn and the one yellow thing on screen; £20.51 is the number that decides it; the end card concedes.

beats.on_screen: 3.30% · A £4 COFFEE, WITH US · It's terrible.
£4.00 SALE · us 13.2p · flat rate, no fee 6.8p · We lose.
£40.00 SALE · us 60.0p · flat rate, no fee 67.6p · Here we don't.
£20.51 · where the fixed fee stops hurting
NeroPay · Under £20 a sale? Stay where you are. · neropay.app

sound.effects: impact-bass on beat 0 and the £20.51 and end-card landings; whoosh-short on each panel entrance; sparkle on each bar drawing; chime when our bar turns yellow; click-soft on each editorial line; riser (last 3 s of the file) into £20.51
